newsitem.title: USA: DI sets South Texas drilling acquisition.
newsitem.headline: DI sets South Texas drilling acquisition.

text.p: DI Industries Inc said it has tentatively agreed to acquire 10 land drilling rigs, 18 trucks, a yard facility in Alice, Texas, and various other equipment for between $24 and $26 million in cash.
DI said it signed a letter of intent to acquire all the South Texas operational assets of Diamond M Onshore Inc, a Diamond Offshore Drilling Inc subsidiary.
It is expected the acquisition will close by December 31, DI said, noting all the drilling rigs are currently operating.
It said the transaction "will give us the critical mass in South Texas necessary for DI to be a strong competitior in this geographic region." -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
